ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary of the financial document:  20 Microns Limited reported a return to revenue growth in Q2 FY27 and improved H1 gross margins, yet experienced a material decline in H1 EBITDA (-5.5%) and PAT (-8.3%), primarily due to elevated energy and freight costs. While the company maintains a strong balance sheet and is executing strategic investments, including a ₹100 Cr capacity expansion into specialty products and captive mine acquisitions, the immediate red flag is the failure to translate top-line and gross margin improvements into operating profit growth. Management aims to recover operating margins in H2 through pricing and efficiency, alongside securing raw material supply and leveraging positive tailwinds like the anti-dumping duty on TiO2.
